title: 440 Turk Street missed its construction target. Who actually got paid?

beats.text: San Francisco planned two sites, then put offices and client access together at 440 Turk Street.

visual.sub: The City dropped a proposed second lease

beats.text: The Board tabled the proposed office lease.

visual.kicker: The City dropped a proposed second lease

beats.text: The revised project budget included the property and equipment.
Public Works described emergency negotiations with Pankow Builders.

visual.kicker: A different builder won the solicitation

beats.text: The City signed with Fisher Development on June 20.
Construction and move-in were targeted for May or June 2019.

visual.kicker: Completion followed the May or June target

beats.text: Substantial completion came on July 31. Final completion came in September.
The Controller records 37 voucher lines for the builder.

visual.kicker: Three fiscal years of checks match the contract register

beats.text: The checks span three fiscal years. They cover the builder, while the larger project budget also covered the property.
Together they match the amount recorded for the prime contractor.

visual.label: Three fiscal years of checks match the contract register
